outline:
 To develop an understanding of how the operations, have strategic importance and can provide a competitive advantage in the workplace.
 To understand the relationship between operations and other business functions.
 To understand techniques of location and facility planning; line balancing; job designing; and capacity planning in operations management.
 To understand the Materials Management function starting from Demand Management through Inventory Management.
schedule:
•	Operations Strategy & Managing Change
•	Project Management
•	Process Analysis; Product Design & Process Selection
•	Facility Layout & Waiting Line Management
•	TQM focused on SIX SIGMA
•	Supply Chain Strategy; Strategic Capacity Planning
•	JIT & Lean Production System
•	Production Forecasting
•	Aggregate Operations Planning & Yield Management
•	Inventory System
•	Material Requirements Planning (MRP) & Enterprise Resource Planning (ERP)
•	Operations Scheduling
